purpose: Track high-value open world-model projects as benchmark teachers and compare their measurable techniques without copying protected implementation.
ranking: Prefer reproducibility, evidence quality, open licensing, benchmark usefulness, capability diversity, and independence from one architecture.
learning_rule: Extract benchmark techniques and engineering principles; generate original DreamCo implementations and regression tests.
review_rule: Recheck licenses, model/data availability, hardware requirements, and project status before integrating any dependency.
